title: i18n final sweep: lint rule repo-wide, pt-BR glossary review, runtime check in en / pt-BR / pseudo-locale
notes:
Sweep: English 'by the {day}th' in plan.mobile home.stillNeededByDay is wrong for 1st/2nd/3rd (pre-existing); reword to avoid ordinals. Verify ui/categoryPick.ts 'Ready to Assign' label and useBudgetModel().error / creditOverspendHint detail got translated by ui-shell and core slices.
Sweep: banks.bank sheet.bank.reference still says 'Your balance in syscd' (old app name) in both languages; change to Budget. connect-bank/useSyncRunner.ts passes 'Sync'/'Re-import' as a discriminator to model/syncRun describeSyncOutcome with a disable comment: confirm banks-core translated the sentences and the discriminator is not shown raw.
Sweep items from slice reports: (1) switch SHARED_LABEL consumers to sharedLabel() (features/plan/RowMenu.tsx, features/people/PersonFilterBar.tsx, PersonPicker.tsx) and delete the constant; (2) state edit.ageNow is 'agora' in English too (pre-existing Portuguese word pinned by planEdits.test.ts): make en 'now' and update that test; (3) client/src/platform/api/baseQuery.ts raw 'Network request failed' and 'HTTP <status>' messages; (4) NameField/AvatarEditor show RTK error.message first: route through apiErrorMessage; @/profile/model checkDisplayName/uploadErrorMessage were in core slice, verify; (5) ConnectedAppsScreen local ISO date formatter; (6) accounts.register conv.rate uses toFixed(4), decimal separator not localized; (7) CSV export headers in txnRowMenuShared.ts left English (data format); (8) admin/index.html static title + lang; docs/i18n.md says admin has no language setting, now stale; (9) review admin pt-BR 'recurso' for feature and 'Função' for role; plan 'Pronto para atribuir · casa'.
Sweep items (batch 2): (10) Delete-budget confirmation: pt-BR prompt says Digite "delete"; isDeleteArmed only accepts 'delete' — accept the localized word too (logic + test); (11) Reflect 'Change +1.5%' uses toFixed(1), decimal separator not localized; (12) term consistency across slices for words outside the glossary: Working Balance 'Saldo atual', Match/Unmatch 'Associar/Desassociar', Closed group 'Encerradas', register 'registro', Tracking Account, Running Balance; balance labels masculine (Compensado/Pendente) next to Saldo vs feminine for transactions; (13) accounts ellipsis menu hint mentions 'Link Account' which the menu lacks (pre-existing); (14) spending slice already maps 'Reconciliation Adjustment' for display: fold into displaySystemName from budget-rzfm.
Sweep (15): native Pluggy widget appends undocumented language=<pt|en> query param to hosted connect URL; verify against a real connect URL on device.
Sweep (16) from budget-rzfm: two pluggyKeys.logic tests pin raw server text for non-specific codes ('boom', 'nope'), so saveErrorView/deleteErrorMessage still show English there: switch to apiErrorMessage(err, fallback) and update those two tests; (17) features/plan/RowMenu.tsx menuRowName shows 'Credit Card Payments' untranslated because name also seeds the rename draft: split display name from draft seed; (18) register inline payee field shows stored 'Starting Balance' after picking 'Saldo inicial'; (19) docs/i18n.md API errors section: document params and server_* codes.
Final sweep done: one lint manifest per package; heuristic hunt + running-app walk (xa, pt-BR, phone width, admin). Fixed: network/HTTP errors, TargetEditor and avatar raw errors, pluggy keys server text, admin ApiError text + enum labels, combobox create row, import account group, keypad done, payee last-used date, date-range hint, system names; glossary and docs updated. 36 screenshots attached.
Approved by the owner in chat 2026-11-21. Already merged into main; verified on merged main: typecheck + lint pass, bun test shared 163 / client 1227 / admin 20 / api 1190 (compose PG :55432), 0 fail. Shipped with the i18n release (epic budget-m2ve).
